title: Steve Angle, Edgar Mosley and drum help
summary: Steve Angle in the George Williams band, and Howard helping Edgar Mosley with bass drum.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: What about this guy, Steve Angle?
Oh yeah, Steve worked with me too.
Well, we worked off and on in the George Williams band, the brass band.
Well, you worked with George Williams too, huh?
Yeah, I worked with all the bands.
What about Edgar Mosley? You talk a lot about that. Did you work much with Edgar?
It was the main band. It played, I'm the one who started it on the drums. He used to play the bass drum in the band, and I helped him a lot with the traps. I see.
So you did a little teaching of?
Yeah, I was treating him out. I could help him because I know there's something about it. If I wanted to do something, if he couldn't get it, I could get out and do it for him.
I heard you play drums one night. Abby Williams left the stand up at Fumpin' Manny. Yeah.
I used to play pretty good. Did you ever teach anybody trumpet? No. You never tried that, huh?
